name: Solve Well in Wellington 2025

venue.name: Victoria University of Wellington, Kelburn Campus
venue.address: Victoria University of Wellington, Kelburn, Wellington 6012

information:
Solve Well in Wellington 2025 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition.

This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.

Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.
